final: WITH linked AS (SELECT s.telescref, o.weathprofile, s.modindex, s.phaseshiftdeg FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM linked), groups AS (SELECT telescref, weathprofile, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex, AVG(phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase_shift FROM linked GROUP BY telescref, weathprofile), kept AS (SELECT g.* FROM groups AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.avg_modindex > b.avg_modindex) SELECT weathprofile, AVG(avg_modindex) AS avg_group_modindex, AVG(avg_phase_shift) AS avg_group_phase_shift, AVG(avg_modindex - (SELECT avg_modindex FROM baseline)) AS avg_amount_above_baseline FROM kept GROUP BY weathprofile
